title: Commission independent architecture review to validate NSA vs SA migration path
description: Engage an independent vendor-neutral architecture consultant to validate the NSA architecture decision and recommend a migration path to SA. Deliverable: architecture assessment report within 60 days. Output to be reviewed by CTO and Architecture Review Board.

title: Develop revised CapEx model including all hidden integration and migration costs
description: Finance and Network Operations to jointly develop a revised CapEx model for the Phase 2 project that includes all hidden integration costs identified during the post-decision review. The revised model must be reviewed by the CFO before any further project expenditure is approved.

title: Establish mandatory cross-functional review gate for all technical decisions above ₹2 crore
description: Update the decision-making framework to require sign-off from at least two independent domain architects and the Finance Controller before any technical decision above ₹2 crore CapEx is ratified. Framework to be approved by the CISO and CTO within 30 days.

title: Emergency capacity upgrade on Bengaluru-Mumbai optical transport segment
description: Expedite procurement and installation of additional 100G capacity on the Bengaluru-Mumbai optical transport segment. Target: restore 30% headroom within 30 days. This is the primary corrective action that will unblock the optical transport project.

title: Implement real-time optical transport utilisation alerting at 70% threshold
description: Deploy automated alerting on all optical transport segments when utilisation exceeds 70% of rated capacity. Alert to trigger automatic NOC escalation and capacity review. Implementation to be completed within 14 days across all 22 circles.

title: Conduct capacity model review for IoT platform traffic across all circles
description: Review and update the capacity model for IoT platform traffic across all circles. Engage the IoT platform team and Network Capacity Planning to produce a revised 12-month demand forecast. Output to be used in the next capacity planning cycle.

title: Update enterprise SLA incident response runbook for optical transport events
description: Update the enterprise SLA incident response runbook to include specific diagnostic steps for optical transport capacity breaches. Include threshold values and escalation contacts. Runbook to be reviewed and approved by the NOC Lead within 21 days.

title: Establish monthly capacity review board for transport layer planning
description: Establish a monthly Capacity Review Board chaired by the Head of Network Operations. Board to review optical transport utilisation trends, upcoming events, and capacity upgrade pipeline. First meeting to be held within 45 days.

title: Apply ECMP Policy Rollback Across All MX480 Chassis in Mumbai Circle
